title: VSEPR theory
basic_overview: Electron domains arrange to minimise repulsion; lone-pair repulsions are stronger than bond-pair repulsions.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Draw Lewis structure. 2. Count domains. 3. Set electron geometry. 4. Remove lone pairs from the shape name.
extra_info_content.factors: Multiple bonds count as one domain but exert stronger repulsion.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
